sources.quote:
由于这一季课程将在几周后结束，我们希望学生们能坚持按时上课。如果需要请假，请家长们至
少提前 24 小时通知我们。谢谢大家，也祝小朋友们上课愉快！[愉快]

As the current season of classes will come to a close in a few weeks, we kindly request that all students
make a consistent effort to attend classes. In the event of any absences, it would be greatly appreciated if
we are notified at least 24 hours in advance. Thank you

Hello Parents,

家长们大家好，

Thank you everyone for participating in this season’s Peer Tutoring. We are very sorry that the lessons
taught by David and Taichi this summer had been very inconsistent. We had contacted the tutors many
times, however, we didn’t receive any actionable response. Because of this situation, we had decided to
end the season early. We apologize for your experience during this season. Normally, our tutors are
responsible and teach classes regularly. We hope to see you all in the Peer Tutoring Program in the future.
Thank you very much for your feedback and your patience and understanding.


感谢大家参加我们这一季的同伴辅导课程。我们很抱歉David和Taichi一直没有给大家好好上课。
我们多次联系过老师，但是我们没有收到老师们回应怎么把课上的更好。由于这个情况，我们决
定提前结束这一季给大家的课。我们十分抱歉您这一季的上课经历不好。通常，我们的老师们是
负责的并且会每一周按时教课的。我们希望能在下一季的同伴辅导项目中见到大家。非常感谢大
家的反馈以及大家的耐心和理解。

Thank you everyone.

谢谢大家。



各位家长好！ 随着我们的夏季2021Peer Tutoring项目的结束，我们希望大家可以填写一份调查问
卷，以便于我们提升自己的Peer Tutoring活动。 我们真诚的感谢大家参与这个项目，希望秋季再
见！

大家好！非常感谢大家这一季参加我们的同伴辅导项目。来帮助我们进一步改进这个项目，我们
希望大家可以填写一份调查问卷。感谢大家积极参与，希望夏季再见！

Hello Jeffrey, due to many missed lessons, your irresponsibility is unacceptable as a tutor. YIV
supervisors have made the decision to not provide you with volunteer hours. Thank you.

您好，我们跟老师取得了联系，然后她表示3:30-4:15pm 的上课时间可能对您来说太匆忙了。我们
建议把上课时间调到4:00-4:45pm，来确保双方都能准时上课。同时我们也会提醒老师让她提前
5-10分钟打开Zoom。

sources.quote:
我们感谢并且希望您能继续对老师保持耐心的态度，因为他们是义工学生，面对志愿者工作中的
一些特殊情况时，他们也在学习如何更好的和处理和跟您沟通。如果时间不合适，请告诉我们什
么时候会更好，谢谢您

Hi Nancy, due to your frequent and late-noticed absences, classes with Owen and Riley were unable to
run consistently and effectively. Thus, we have made the decision to terminate your role as a tutor. Your
classes will stop starting from next week, thank you for your cooperation.

Hi Ella, Rysa will no longer be continuing her participation in the Peer Tutoring classes. The parent feels
that Rysa has not been learning well in class and decided to withdraw. Classes will stop starting from next
week, thank your for understanding. We understand that you have previously wished to withdraw due to
personal reasons as well, is this something you would still choose?

          Steps to preparing forms/spreadsheets:
                1.   Make copies of the forms above
                2.   Put them into the right folder
                3.   Change details relevant to this season: dates, link to waitlist, etc.
                4.   Link form responses to spreadsheet
                5.   Fix anything else if needed

     2.   Notifications for tutors (contact promotions) and students’ parents (wechat) (communications)
                -    Tutor sign up opens first, then student sign up to gauge for # of guaranteed classes
                -    Waitlist: classes not guaranteed
                -    TEMPLATE: at the very bottom of this document

          Tutor sign up notification:
                -    Instagram & newsletter (promotions department)
                -    Wechat (us) ← we have a wechat volunteer group chat

          Parent notification:
                -    Instagram & newsletter (promotions department)
                -    Wechat (us) ← parent group chat

          Notes regarding student sign up release (after tutor sign up release)
                -    We need to be waiting for the number of student sign up to reach the target number (to make
                     sure we have enough tutors for guaranteed classes)
                          -     E.g. if we have 80 tutor sign up at this moment, we need to cap regular student sign up
                                at 65
                          -     Then open student waitlist for the rest (classes not guaranteed)

     3.   Class pairing (admissions)
                -    Make new sub sheet in master google spreadsheet
                -    Pair students and tutors with fewer availabilities first
                -    Pair siblings with the same tutor if possible, but it doesn’t have to be like this
                -    See 2023 winter spring season spreadsheet for class pairing examples:
                          -     https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1o0GZHuSfB5-Q2jj_IS-O5t7ILbS4OaSgrO
                                eTQ_Ki3dw/edit?usp=sharing

    2.   Fiona’s Account (YIV Communications Manager)
              a.    Wechat ID: yivcanada_pm

3.   Math TA Sign Up Message:

Our Math Teaching Assistant (TA) Program is back for the school year!

󰞹 Have a passion for math? Want to a professional volunteer experience to add your resume while
working under an esteemed math teacher?

📚 Volunteers will be helping with academic classes, from grade 8-12 math courses to advanced
preparation courses like SAT, AP, and IB.

Interested in applying?
⭕ Please send your resume to info@yivcanada.ca
⭕ Ensure that you can commit from September 12th to June 30th, 2022. The position entails a
flexible workload of 3-4 hours per week!

Please let us know if you have any questions and we look forward to viewing your application.


    4.   Group Chat Messages:

Hi everyone! I am YIV’s Fiona who will be your contact for any problems during the classes! Thank
you all for your participation in our program!

The first day of class will be the week of October 2, 2023
